items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: Now, he taught the other brother, see? And the other brother, he's come out great too, because his brother taught him, see?

ctx.x: Were they Mexicans or just studied?

Well, I wouldn't say they're Mexicans, but they had some Spanish blood in them, you understand what I mean? My grandfather was from France and my grandmother was from Hattie, see? Well, that was the beginning of my family, yeah, see? So we mixed up. But he studied in Mexico, you see? And that's why he was such a great musician. Now, he taught the other brother, see?
